raw_tokens.value: Warpriest Bonus Feat ~ Earth Child Binder
6,CATEGORY=FEAT,Earth Child Style,Earth Child Topple,Greater Trip,Improved Trip,Improved Unarmed Strike,Stunning Fist
Even the greatest giants fear your technique.

You can trip a creature of the giant subtype no matter its size. While you are using Earth Child Style, when a prone creature of the giant subtype stands up and provokes an attack of opportunity from you, if you make an unarmed strike, you can declare you are making a Stunning Fist attempt after the attack hits. You gain a +4 bonus to the DC of any Stunning Fist effect you deliver in this way. &nl; [Normal] You can only trip opponents who are one size category larger than you.
